subject: Mutual Action Plan — next steps & recap (ACME discovery)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — next steps & recap (ACME discovery)

Hi Lydia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can put together a short mutual action plan (MAP):

Key pain points
- User-facing search suggestions currently show high tail latency (p95 ~350ms) that impacts conversions.
- Cost spikes during nightly batch model runs and during growth events.
- Data residency and compliance: some PII flows through inference that needs to remain in-region.

Goals
- Reduce inference p95 latency for suggestions to <100ms.
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~30% through batching/quantization and better routing.
- Validate private deployment options (VPC or on-prem) for regulated workloads.

Stakeholders we heard today
- Lydia Chen — Head of Search & Relevance (day-to-day owner)
- Tom Wallace — Director, Product (decision owner)
- Evan Brooks — VP Product (exec sign-off)
- Procurement (procurement@acme.com) — contracts

Proposed immediate next steps
1) I’ll share a short MAP doc with milestones, owners, and dates. (see attachment to follow)
2) Pilot: lightweight integration to test latency & cost on a subset of queries (target pilot by mid-September).
3) Pricing worksheet and terms for procurement review.

Can you confirm the stakeholders above and the target pilot date? If there are any additional constraints (security, procurement timelines, or internal review cycles) please flag them.

Happy to sync again if you want to walk through the MAP live — I can schedule a 30-minute follow-up next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

---
Attachments: placeholder (will send full MAP and terms in follow-up)

From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>

Cc: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acme.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — next steps & recap (ACME discovery)

Thanks Marissa — this matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Decision process: Evan (VP Product) will sign off after Tom’s recommendation; Legal will review any contract language; procurement will need standard 2-week review after receiving SOW/price.
- Timeline: Our ideal target is to have a working pilot by 2026-09-15 so we can evaluate before our October planning cycle.
- Success metrics for the pilot: p95 <120ms for the test slice, sustained throughput for peak hour traffic, no cross-region data egress for the pilot traffic.

Please share the MAP + pricing/terms so procurement can begin a preliminary review. Also loop in anyone from your side who should join an exec-level 30-minute review — I expect Evan to join that call.

Appreciate it —
Lydia
Head of Search & Relevance, ACME Corp
lydia.chen@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acme.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan — ACME MAP (v3) + milestones

Lydia / Tom — attaching the MAP v3 (ACME-MAP-v3.xlsx) and our standard terms summary (redwood-terms.pdf). Below is a condensed Mutual Action Plan we can use in the exec review and to track progress.

Mutual Action Plan (condensed)
1) Pilot setup — Integration & data prep
   - Owner: ACME (Lydia) / Redwood engineering (Vivek)
   - Tasks: define test query slice, set up API keys, confirm in-region endpoint, run smoke tests
   - Decision criteria: successful smoke test, p95 <120ms on test slice
   - Target date: start 2026-08-24, complete by 2026-09-08
2) Pilot evaluation — Metrics & tuning
   - Owner: ACME analytics (Tom) / Redwood SRE (Rafael)
   - Tasks: monitor latency/cost, apply batching/quantization profiles, compare cost baseline
   - Decision criteria: cost reduction >=20% and p95 <120ms OR agreed tradeoff documented
   - Target date: 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-22
3) Procurement & legal review
   - Owner: ACME procurement / Redwood commercial (Marissa)
   - Tasks: finalize SOW, pricing worksheet, security addendum (if private deployment required)
   - Decision criteria: Signed SOW or PO
   - Target date: procurement kickoff upon MAP receipt; target sign by 2026-09-30
4) Production rollout planning
   - Owner: ACME infra & Redwood partners
   - Tasks: scale testing, fallback policies, SLA and monitoring setup
   - Target date: contingent on successful pilot and procurement; aim for October planning window
Open items for Redwood
- Provide pricing worksheet updated for pilot (line items + pilot discount) — Rafael, can you prepare?
- Provide T&Cs and security addendum for in-region deployment — sending redwood-terms.pdf as a starting point.
Next step
- I’ll set up a 30-minute exec review for 2026-08-25 at 10:00am PT (tentative) to run through the MAP and confirm decision owners. Please confirm availability.
Thanks — we’ll follow up with the workbook and a short slide deck for the exec call.
Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: ACME-MAP-v3.xlsx, redwood-terms.pdf

From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acme.com>

Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — ACME MAP (v3) + milestones

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear milestones. Confirming a few items:
- Evan can join the exec review on 2026-08-25 at 10:00am PT — I’ll block his calendar.
- Procurement will begin a preliminary review once we receive the pricing worksheet; procurement@acme.com is on copy.
- We’d like to see the pricing worksheet by 2026-08-22 so Tom (Product) and I can prep the internal recommendation.

Rafael, would it be possible to have an initial pricing worksheet (pilot pricing + expected monthly run-rate at scale) by EOD 2026-08-22? That will help us keep to the timeline.

Assuming that timeline, we’ll treat 2026-09-15 as the target pilot start window and reconfirm at the exec review.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the call.

Tom Wallace
Director, Product | ACME Corp
